column1: # Update parts (docs/adr/0032): which files under src/ belong to which part.
# One part per line: name, then path patterns (relative to src/, * within a
# folder, ** across folders). The first line that matches a file wins; core
# takes the rest. A part named like a feature (src/features.tsv) shows as an
# update on that feature's row in the control centre.
